newsitem.title: CHINA: China stock markets to rise steadily in 1997-paper.
newsitem.headline: China stock markets to rise steadily in 1997-paper.

text.p: The Shanghai Securities News on Monday said China's stock markets will rise steadily in 1997 on the back of an improved national economy.
Shanghai's composite index would rise to more than 1,100 points in 1997, the newspaper said in a commentary. The index closed at 1,017 points last Friday.
"The improved macro-economy and financial conditions dictate that stock indices will have an upward trend in 1997," it said.
The newspaper said China's economy was expected to grow by a year-on-year nine percent in 1997 with retail price inflation falling further from last year's 6.1 percent.
"There will a new round of economic growth and a fresh peak of investment during the year," it said.
"Sustained and steady growth will be the major trend of the national economy."
"With the national economy improving, stock markets will rise accordingly," it added.
